characters.name: Red
characters.description: An 11-year-old boy drawn like the anime's hero: a red and white cap, a blue short-sleeved vest over a black T-shirt, jeans, fingerless green gloves and a yellow backpack. Lean, quick silhouette with bold ink outlines that reads clearly from above.
lines: Hang in there, Pikachu, Potion coming!

card.blurb: A kid from Pallet Town setting out to fill Oak's Pokedex.

characters.name: Pikachu
characters.description: A small yellow electric mouse with long black-tipped ears, red cheek pouches, two brown back stripes and a lightning-bolt tail. It runs on all fours in battle, stands upright when curious and sparks from its cheeks.
lines: Pikachu... (turns away from the Poke Ball)

card.blurb: An Electric runner that refuses its Poke Ball and walks beside Red.

characters.name: Professor Oak
characters.description: A grey-haired professor in a long white lab coat over a red shirt and khaki trousers. Kindly and slightly stooped.
lines: It's unsafe! Wild Pokemon live in tall grass!
Oh, Red! How is my old Pokemon?

card.blurb: Kanto's Pokemon professor, who gave Red his Pikachu and the Pokedex.

characters.name: Gary
characters.description: Oak's grandson, drawn like the anime rival: spiky brown hair, a purple shirt, black trousers and a pendant. He stands with his hands in his pockets, smirking.
lines: Gramps! I'm fed up with waiting!
What? Why did you pick that Pikachu?

card.blurb: Red's rival, who snatched the Eevee and never stops showing off.

characters.name: Eevee
characters.description: A small brown fox-like Pokemon with long pointed ears, a bushy cream ruff and a fluffy cream-tipped tail.

card.blurb: Gary's Normal runner, fast and scrappy.

characters.name: The Old Man of Viridian
characters.description: A thin old man with a white moustache, a brown cardigan and a walking stick. At first he lies sprawled across the north road, then he stands chipper after his coffee.
lines: You can't go through here! This is private property!
Ahh, I've had my coffee now and I feel great!
First, you need to weaken the target Pokemon.

card.blurb: He blocks the north road until his coffee, then shows Red how to catch.

characters.name: Pidgey
characters.description: A small plump brown bird with a cream belly, a pink beak and feet, and a black and cream crest. It hovers about a metre and a half up in battle, wings beating, with a crisp shadow beneath it.

card.blurb: A Normal and Flying flier. It hovers over ledges and dodges far, but Rock moves knock it down.

characters.name: Rattata
characters.description: A small purple rat with a cream belly, big buck teeth, long whiskers and a curled tail.

card.blurb: A Normal runner that charges the moment it sees you.

characters.name: Spearow
characters.description: A small brown bird with ruffled feathers, a short hooked beak and red-edged wings, always scowling.

card.blurb: A fierce Normal and Flying flier found on Route 22, and one of Gary's team.

characters.name: Caterpie
characters.description: A green caterpillar with a yellow segmented belly, a red forked antenna and big black eyes. It clings to forest trunks and hugs the ground in battle, curling tight to dodge.

card.blurb: A Bug crawler. Slow and low, so wide sweeps pass over it, and its String Shot slows its foes.

characters.name: Weedle
characters.description: A tan hairy caterpillar with a pink nose, a sharp stinger on its head and another on its tail.

card.blurb: A Bug and Poison crawler whose Poison Sting can poison.

characters.name: Bug Catcher
characters.description: One of Viridian Forest's Bug Catchers: a small boy in a straw hat, white vest and shorts, with a big butterfly net.
lines: Hey! You have Pokemon! Come on! Let's battle 'em!
Yo! You can't jam out if you're a Pokemon trainer!

card.blurb: The forest's Bug Catchers, with Yellow's Caterpie, Weedle, Metapod and Kakuna.

characters.name: Jr. Trainer
characters.description: A boy in a cap, a blue T-shirt and shorts, standing guard partway into Pewter Gym.
lines: Stop right there, kid! You're light years from facing Brock!
Darn! Light years isn't time! It measures distance!

card.blurb: Pewter Gym's trainer, with Yellow's Diglett and Sandshrew.

characters.name: Brock
characters.description: A tall 15-year-old with spiky brown hair, squinting eyes, an orange shirt under a green vest and brown trousers. Solid, grounded stance.
lines: I'm Brock! I'm Pewter's Gym Leader!
I believe in rock hard defense and determination!
I took you for granted. As proof of your victory, here's the Boulder Badge!

card.blurb: Pewter City's Gym Leader, who trusts in rock-hard defence.

characters.name: Geodude
characters.description: A round grey boulder with a craggy face, heavy brows and two thick muscular arms.

card.blurb: A Rock and Ground crawler that curls up and tackles. Electric does nothing to it.

characters.name: Onix
characters.description: A colossal serpent of grey boulders linked into a chain, with a horn on its craggy head. It coils and rears high over the arena, turning slowly and sweeping its tail wide.

card.blurb: Brock's Rock and Ground giant. It never dodges, Electric does nothing to it, and its Bide pays back double.

characters.name: Jessie
characters.description: A Team Rocket agent with long magenta hair swept into a huge curl, a white uniform with a red R, a black top and long black gloves.

card.blurb: Half of Yellow's Team Rocket duo, who keep turning up after Pikachu.

characters.name: James
characters.description: A Team Rocket agent with lavender hair, a white uniform with a red R and a rose in hand.
lines: Looks like Team Rocket's blasting off again!

card.blurb: Jessie's partner, dramatic and unlucky.

characters.name: Meowth
characters.description: A cream cat Pokemon with a gold coin charm on its forehead, whiskers and a curled brown-tipped tail.

card.blurb: Team Rocket's Normal runner, fast with its claws.

characters.name: Misty
characters.description: A girl with an orange side ponytail, a yellow crop top, red braces and denim shorts.
lines: My policy is an all out offensive with Water-type Pokemon!

card.blurb: Cerulean's Gym Leader, who fights from the water with Staryu and Starmie.

characters.name: Starmie
characters.description: A purple ten-pointed double star with a glowing red jewel core. It spins through water like a blade.

card.blurb: Misty's ace swimmer, which dives out of reach and spins in from the water.

characters.name: Giovanni
characters.description: A tall, broad man in a sharp orange suit with slicked-back hair.
lines: So! I must say, I am impressed you got here!
Team Rocket captures Pokemon from around the world!
Blaaargh! I must leave for a while.

card.blurb: Team Rocket's boss, and the secret Viridian Gym Leader.
